title: Incentive-Responsive Agents: A Principal-Agent Framework, Metric Suite, and Runtime Architecture for Long-Lived Personal AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.15515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personal AI agents now persist: they hold accounts, mailboxes, long-term memory, and open-ended task streams, yet the dominant way to improve them remains capability-side: prompt engineering, larger models, longer thinking, and retrieval. We argue that long-lived agents are missing an incentive layer. We formalize an incentive not as text in a prompt but as a runtime contract over the agent's operating point (model tier, test-time compute, memory budget, tool authority, task priority, verification, and compensation) that the agent's policy must causally consume. We develop a principal-agent model with hidden effort, a contractible operating point, and costly verification. We derive (i) a non-consumption invariance principle separating genuine incentives from prompt-level persuasion, (ii) a persistence-as-discount theorem making identity continuity a precondition for sustained effort, (iii) an incentive-capability exchange-rate frontier y

translated_title: 激励响应型智能体：面向长生命周期个人AI智能体的委托-代理框架、指标套件与运行时架构
translated_abstract: 个人AI智能体如今已经具备持久性：它们拥有账户、邮箱、长期记忆以及开放式任务流，然而改进它们的主流方式仍然停留在能力层面：提示工程、更大的模型、更长的思考时间以及检索。我们认为，长生命周期智能体所缺失的是一个激励层。我们将激励形式化定义为并非提示中的文本，而是一个关于智能体运行点（模型层级、测试时计算量、记忆预算、工具权限、任务优先级、验证与补偿）的运行时契约，智能体的策略必须因果地消费该契约。我们构建了一个包含隐藏努力、可契约化运行点和高成本验证的委托-代理模型。我们推导出：（i）非消费不变性原理，用以区分真正的激励与提示层面的说服；（ii）持久性即折扣定理，使身份连续性成为持续努力的前提条件；（iii）激励-能力汇率前沿……
tldr: 该论文针对长生命周期个人AI智能体提出委托-代理激励框架，将激励形式化为智能体运行时必须因果消费的运行时契约，并给出非消费不变性原理、持久性即折扣定理和激励-能力汇率前沿等核心理论成果与指标体系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a principal-agent incentive framework for long-lived personal AI agents, formalizing incentives as runtime contracts over the agent's operating point that the agent's policy must causally consume, and derives key results including a non-consumption invariance principle, a persistence-as-discount theorem, and an incentive-capability exchange-rate frontier.
